---
name: Unit test bug report
about: Report a bug that has been  found when implementing unit tests for the provided
  library.
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Environment**
Test environment (OS) and version (for example, 22).

**To Reproduce**
Run the unit tests dedicated for the function that has the bug, for example.

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Evidence**
***Screenshots***
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain the bug.
***Test logs***
If applicable, add test logs to help explain the bug.

**Severity and priority**
Use the classification introduced in the test plan.

**Resolution**
Recommended fix and assignee, if can be provided.
